# Spookwerk

> Spookwerk is an app studio in the Netherlands building privacy-first iOS apps. Apps process data on-device wherever possible and are free downloads with a one-time unlock — no subscriptions, no ads, no tracking.

## Apps

- [Vitadatum](https://spookwerk.app/apps/vitadatum/): export your Apple Health data to CSV, entirely on-device. iPhone. Now on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/vitadatum/id6763707308). ([Privacy](https://spookwerk.app/apps/vitadatum/privacy/), [Support](https://spookwerk.app/apps/vitadatum/support/))
- [HuurScan](https://spookwerk.app/apps/huurscan/): check the indicative legal maximum rent for a Dutch home using the statutory WWS points system. iPhone. Now on the [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/huurscan/id6777383544). ([Privacy](https://spookwerk.app/apps/huurscan/privacy/), [Support](https://spookwerk.app/apps/huurscan/support/))
- [BlazeWatch](https://spookwerk.app/apps/blazewatch/): pan-European wildfire awareness — satellite-detected fires (NASA FIRMS, Copernicus EFFIS) with filtered proximity alerts for saved places. iPhone. In development, launching 2027; waitlist open on the app page.

## Blog

- [Spookwerk Blog](https://spookwerk.app/blog/): stories from the workshop — building an AI-powered app studio. Also in [Dutch](https://spookwerk.app/blog/nl/).
- [Why I built an Apple Health CSV exporter](https://spookwerk.app/blog/posts/en/why-i-built-an-apple-health-csv-exporter.html)
- [How to export Apple Health data to CSV](https://spookwerk.app/blog/posts/en/how-to-export-apple-health-to-csv.html): Apple Health's built-in export gives you XML, not CSV — how to actually get CSV (convert the XML yourself, or use Vitadatum). Includes a FAQ.
- [Is my rent too high? Calculate your max rent (Dutch WWS)](https://spookwerk.app/blog/posts/en/is-my-rent-too-high-calculate-max-rent-wws.html): how to calculate the legal maximum rent for a Dutch home using the statutory WWS points system.
